original_question: For each s, is the algebraic transfer Tr_s: F_2 tensor_{GL_s} P H_*(B V_s) -> Ext_A^{s,s+*}(F_2, F_2) injective? Equivalently, does Singer's open conjecture hold that Tr_s is a monomorphism for every s?
target_in_paper: Section 2, in the motivation immediately after Conjecture 2.1: the unnumbered statement that Singer's open conjecture predicts the algebraic transfer Tr_s is a monomorphism for every s. ([msp.org](https://msp.org/gtm/2007/11/gtm-2007-11-020s.pdf))
correct_elements: Your draft correctly identifies the mod-2 setting, the algebraic transfer Tr_s, its source as GL_s-coinvariants of primitives in H_*(BV_s), its Ext target, and the substance of the open problem: whether Tr_s is injective/monic for every s. This is exactly the Singer-conjecture sentence used in Section 2 to motivate Conjecture 2.1. ([msp.org](https://msp.org/gtm/2007/11/gtm-2007-11-020s.pdf))
missing_details: The paper presents the transfer degreewise: Tr_s^d: F_2 tensor_{GL_s} PH_d(BV_s) -> Ext_A^{s,s+d}(F_2,F_2). A fully stand-alone question should say explicitly that injectivity is asked in every degree d >= 0, or equivalently for the graded direct sum over d. ([msp.org](https://msp.org/gtm/2007/11/gtm-2007-11-020s.pdf))
s should be quantified as a positive integer s >= 1. ([msp.org](https://msp.org/gtm/2007/11/gtm-2007-11-020s.pdf))
V_s should be identified as an s-dimensional vector space over F_2. ([msp.org](https://msp.org/gtm/2007/11/gtm-2007-11-020s.pdf))
A should be identified as the mod-2 Steenrod algebra. ([msp.org](https://msp.org/gtm/2007/11/gtm-2007-11-020s.pdf))

PH_*(BV_s) should be defined as the primitive part of H_*(BV_s), namely the homology classes annihilated by all positive-degree Steenrod operations. ([msp.org](https://msp.org/gtm/2007/11/gtm-2007-11-020s.pdf))

To stay paper-faithful, it helps to note that this is background motivation in Section 2 rather than a numbered conjecture of the paper itself; the formal numbered statement there is Conjecture 2.1 about Sq^0. ([msp.org](https://msp.org/gtm/2007/11/gtm-2007-11-020s.pdf))
refined_question: For every integer s >= 1, let V_s be an s-dimensional vector space over F_2, let A be the mod-2 Steenrod algebra, and let PH_d(BV_s) subset H_d(BV_s) denote the primitive subspace consisting of homology classes annihilated by all positive-degree Steenrod operations. Is Singer's algebraic transfer a monomorphism in rank s; that is, is the graded map Tr_s = direct sum over d >= 0 of Tr_s^d, where Tr_s^d: F_2 tensor_{GL_s} PH_d(BV_s) -> Ext_A^{s,s+d}(F_2,F_2), injective for every s? ([msp.org](https://msp.org/gtm/2007/11/gtm-2007-11-020s.pdf))
justification: The draft does not match the paper's formal Conjecture 2.1, but it does match the unnumbered Singer-transfer conjecture stated in the motivation immediately after Conjecture 2.1: Section 2 defines Tr_s, V_s, and PH_*(BV_s), records the known isomorphism cases s = 1, 2, 3, notes that Tr_5 is not isomorphic, and then states Singer's open prediction that Tr_s should be a monomorphism for any s. The commutative Sq^0 diagram and Theorem 2.3 then explain the grading and why this injectivity question is being invoked there. ([msp.org](https://msp.org/gtm/2007/11/gtm-2007-11-020s.pdf))

citations.label: unnumbered Singer-transfer motivation (Tr_s is a monomorphism for any s)
